changelog:
Initial release of the Data Retention Policy Skill.

- Generates a data retention schedule tied to legal/business basis, with defined periods and deletion methods.
- Flags data categories with missing retention periods or justification.
- Includes guidance on required inputs, schedule format, and deletion mechanics.
- Provides a script to validate schedules and calculate deletion dates.
- Outlines quality checks and common anti-patterns to ensure compliance and risk minimization.
